title: My Free Time
text:
My name is Ali. I like to play football on Saturday. My friend Ayse likes to read books at home.

On Sunday I go to the park with my dad. We ride bikes and have a picnic. I am happy on Sunday.

questions.text: What does Ali like to play on Saturday?
Where does Ali go on Sunday?
Why is Ali happy on Sunday?
options: He spends time with his dad

questions.text: How do Ali and his dad probably feel during the picnic?

vocabulary.definition: a meal eaten outdoors, often in a park
a public place with grass and trees
to travel by sitting on and moving a bike

paragraph_translations: Benim adım Ali. Cumartesi günü futbol oynamayı severim. Arkadaşım Ayşe evde kitap okumayı sever.
Pazar günü babamla parka giderim. Bisiklete binip piknik yaparız. Pazar günü mutluyum.
